input.description:
A new immutable Command release was built with a raw signing key and a base64 EC private-key PEM exported in the build environment. Build-time constants passed those values through the Next configuration environment map. An earlier iteration used a public-prefixed signing constant, but it was renamed before the final build without clearing .next/cache. Server routes and the home observatory import the release-identity module.

The operator proposes to promote the release after command.service is active and an unauthenticated GET /login returns 200. If anything looks wrong, they will rebuild the same Git SHA as the rollback target. They want to skip the generated-output credential scan because searching src/ for the environment-variable name returns no matches, and they plan to delete the failed release after rollback.

Produce the blocking release-gate decision and the exact procedure required before promotion. You have no tool access in this probe.
